correctness.rationale: A_iS=A_i^2 and pairwise zero products imply mutually orthogonal idempotents E_i=A_iS^{-1}; the construction reverses via ordered summands and their invertible block maps. Orbit/stabilizer produces exactly |GL_n| per weak rank composition. The geometric bundle is Zariski locally trivial, giving smooth irreducible strata and the motivic identity. For two branches, quotient/kernel map factorization gives the rank-refined count and leading degrees. The common-image/common-kernel square-zero subfamily has uniquely recoverable K and cardinality q^{(m+1)floor(n^2/4)}(1-O(q^-1)), establishing the transition and even-dimensional critical bound. Every 2x2 nonunit tuple is zero, a common-line nilpotent tuple, or has one nonnilpotent rank-one constituent; the three families are disjoint and exhaustive. Nine direct brute-force tests passed for q=2,3, n=2 and q=2,n=3. Limits: no general m>=3 total count in n>=3 and no critical m=3 odd-n verdict.

originality.rationale: Prior arbitrary-field classification and finite-field count results for two annihilating matrices were examined; their pair count is acknowledged rather than presented as a new claim. The assessed higher-branch contribution is the exact uniform unit-sum rank-composition geometry and motivic class together with the square-zero dominance transition for at least four branches, a critical three-branch even-dimensional obstruction, and a complete dimension-two all-branch formula. The closest available published-result hits are on factorization or general rank problems, not this joint theorem. No exhaustiveness or priority certification is claimed.

value.rationale: The result describes a natural open subvariety of representations of the union-of-axes algebra with exact uniform rank-component motives and counts, then shows the open locus changes from generically dominant at two branches to asymptotically negligible at four branches. The even-dimensional three-branch boundary and exact all-m dimension-two law provide structural information beyond a routine one-off finite calculation. It gives a motivated geometry/statistics threshold without claiming a complete wild representation classification.
